title: Chinese spy balloon as standard of evidence

tellings.quote: Much like the Chinese spy balloon that floated over US airspace in 2023. Everybody sees it.

plain: A researcher named Michael Shurmer, debating UFOs on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, points to the Chinese spy balloon that floated over the United States in 2023. He says that everybody saw it, and he uses it as an example of the kind of clear, shared evidence he would expect if strange craft were really in the sky.
